text:
maya: heads up — eu-west1 GPU pool is showing lots of tiny free 'pockets' (0.25–1 GPU) and jobs won't pack, cost creeping up :thinking:
liam: can you paste node/pod list? sounds like fragmentation + anti-affinity causing islands
maya: `kubectl get pods -n ml -o wide | grep -E "gpu|node-"` -> several pods in Terminating on node gke-eu-gpu-07
anika: saw this earlier — `kubectl describe pod ml-train-5` shows MountVolume.WaitForAttach for pvc ml-checkpoint, NFS mount timing out
maya: PDBs are blocking eviction too, training-statefulset has `minAvailable: 1` so drains hang
ravi: so drains stall on mounts + PDBs -> scheduler can't evict and pack remaining pods, leaving fractional GPU fragments
sara: we should consider lowering PDB minAvailable for training during maintenance windows to avoid these blobs
liam: quick mitigation idea — cordon + force-delete the stuck pod? risk losing checkpoints though
maya: tried force-delete, kubelet still marks pod Terminating because finalizers waiting on mount detach
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-312 — tag: gpu-fragmentation
anika: workaround that worked for me on one node: remove PV attachment then drain. commands I used:
```
kubectl patch pv pv-ml-checkpoint -p '{"spec":{"persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy":"Delete"}}'
# then
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
sara: risky but it freed ~0.75 GPU and allowed two pending pods to schedule, cost dropped a bit :relieved:
ravi: long-term we need two things: auto-evict policy for stuck mounts + a consolidation scheduler plugin that favors filling node-level GPU capacity rather than strict anti-affinity
liam: also noticed network saturation — big checkpoint transfers saturate rack NICs so nodes are slow to finish termination, exacerbating the hang
maya: agreed. propose: (1) lower aggressive PDBs for non-prod; (2) add an eviction grace override for NFS mount timeout; (3) run a weekly consolidation job to defragment GPU pool
sara: +1, I'll draft an RFC and ping infra leads with cost impact numbers
maya: adding logs and outputs to the incident now
ops-bot: autoscaler note — scaled +3 nodes in eu-west1 during incident window
maya: monitoring continuing, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
